// Generated by zfa
//
// #1102: the SkinRouteContractObserver validates every push
// against the route contract table built from getAllRoutes()
// (declared = conforming). The navigator root '/' (
// RouteContractTable.navigatorRootRoute) conforms by
// construction, so cold start never flags a phantom violation.
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:zuraffa/skin.dart';

import '../skin/skin_contract_auditor.dart';
import 'index.dart';

final GoRouter appRouter = GoRouter(
  routes: getAllRoutes(),
  observers: [
    SkinRouteContractObserver(
      table: RouteContractTable.fromRouteNames(
        getAllRoutes()
            .whereType<GoRoute>()
            .map((route) => route.name ?? route.path)
            .toSet(),
      ),
    ),
  ],
);
